It's time to take action and set up an effective commerce stack that operates independently of traditional payment systems.

content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can set up a fully operational digital storefront that accepts international payments without relying on conventional payment processors. Begin by deploying a simple stack using Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency. With no KYC requirements and support for over 300 cryptocurrencies, you can attract a global audience. This infrastructure allows you to bypass local payment restrictions and access international markets directly. You can have products listed and ready to sell within hours, enabling immediate access to potential buyers.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The Sovereign Starter Stack is your best option for a quick and efficient setup. This stack utilizes GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for accepting payments. For just $97, you can deploy this stack within 48 hours, allowing you to list three products immediately. This infrastructure is designed for creators who need a straightforward solution without the complexities of traditional payment systems. By owning this architecture, you gain full control over your sales and customer data, eliminating dependency on third-party platforms.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on the essential components of your digital commerce stack first. Avoid getting bogged down in unnecessary features or complex integrations. Start with a simple product offering and basic infrastructure. You can expand later as your sales grow. Prioritize setting up your hosting, payment processing, and product delivery mechanisms. These foundational elements will allow you to start selling quickly. Additional features like advanced analytics or marketing tools can come later, once your initial sales are established and you have a clearer understanding of your audience.
Blockchain payments eliminate traditional banking barriers.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To drive your first transaction, ensure your product is correctly loaded, and your payment processing is configured. Test the payment flow using small transactions to confirm that everything works smoothly. Leverage social media and local networks to promote your new store, encouraging friends and contacts to make purchases. Utilize Binance P2P to convert your local currency into cryptocurrency to facilitate sales. Once the transaction is successful, you’ll have a proven process to replicate for future sales, reinforcing your confidence in this sovereign model.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, focus on finalizing your digital storefront. Start by deploying your hosting platform, whether on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Integrate NOWPayments to ensure that international clients can easily pay in cryptocurrency. Load your initial product offerings and conduct test transactions to confirm functionality. Promote your store via social media and relevant online communities to generate interest and drive traffic. Finally, consider investing in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to expand your capabilities and access additional resources for scaling your business.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
USDT on Tron offers instant settlements for under $0.10.

For those looking to establish a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides all the blueprints and templates necessary for building and scaling your digital commerce stack, ensuring you have a robust foundation to reach international markets.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept payments in Bangladesh without PayPal?

Utilize NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment processor that does not require a traditional bank account. This allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies directly, enabling you to bypass PayPal entirely.
What cryptocurrencies can I use for international payments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT on the Tron network, which offers low fees and fast transaction settlements.
Can I sell digital products without a website?
Yes, you can host your store on platforms like Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, allowing you to create a digital storefront without traditional web hosting costs.
Is it safe to use cryptocurrency for transactions?
Yes, utilizing cryptocurrencies like USDT offers secure transactions, and services like NOWPayments ensure that your payments are processed quickly and safely without exposing sensitive information.
